title: RCW 50.24.014, Financing special unemployment assistance - Financing the employment security department's administrative costs - Accounts - Contributions

passages.question: Why is the EAF 0.02% for this employer and not 0.03%?
passages.excerpt: (1)(a) ... Contributions to this account shall accrue and become payable by each employer, except ... at a basic rate of two one-hundredths of one percent. ... (b) ... Contributions to this account shall accrue and become payable by each employer, except ... those qualified employers assigned rate class 20 or rate class 40, as applicable, under RCW 50.29.025, at a basic rate of one one-hundredth of one percent. ... (2)(a) Contributions under this section ... shall not be deducted, in whole or in part, from the remuneration of individuals in the employ of the employer.
